progression_rule: Main lifts (deadlift, bench, step-up): when every set is done with clean form at RPE 8 or easier, add weight next time: deadlift +5 kg, bench and step-up +2.5 kg, row +2.5 kg. If you miss reps, repeat the weight. Miss twice in a row, drop 10% and build back. Chin-ups: add 1 rep per set up to 4x6, then switch to a lighter band and go back to 4x3. Dips: add 1 rep per set up to 3x10 before any added load. Sessions 16-18 are a deload: 2 rounds only, same weights, finish early. Busy-week minimum: 2 rounds of A1 and A3 only (about 20 min). Back after 7+ days off (illness, travel, moving): use 80% of your last weights for 2 sessions, then carry on. Strength is weekdays 5:30-6:30; cardio is separate (weekend or a spare morning) and gets logged as cardio, not here. Sharp pain, numbness or a niggle that isn't settling: stop that lift and see a GP or physio.

days.name: Day A - Deadlift, Bench, Chin
days.warmup: 5 min easy bike. 10 glute bridges, 10 bodyweight box squats, 10 band pull-aparts, 30 s dead hang. Then 2-3 lighter ramp-up sets on deadlift and bench (bar, ~50%, ~75%).

exercises.name: Barbell deadlift
exercises.notes: Brace before each pull, bar close to the shins. Last diary best 120x5, so start well under.

exercises.name: Band-assisted chin-up
exercises.notes: Use the band that lets you get 4 clean reps. Full hang at the bottom, chin over the bar.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
exercises.notes: Shoulder blades pinned, feet planted. Diary best 75x5.

exercises.name: Cable rope face pull
exercises.notes: Pull to the eyebrows, thumbs back. Posture work for the desk days.

days.name: Day B - Step-up, Row, Dip
days.warmup: 5 min easy bike. 10 glute bridges each leg, 10 walking lunges, 10 band pull-aparts, 5 slow bodyweight dips at shallow depth. Ramp-up: 1 set of 6 step-ups each leg with the bar only.

exercises.name: Barbell step-up
exercises.notes: 8 each leg. Knee-height box. Diary best 60x8. Replaces back squat for now.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
exercises.notes: 8 each arm, hand on bench. Diary best about 41.5x5.

exercises.name: Parallel-bar dip (bike seat and treadmill arm)
exercises.notes: Bodyweight only. Go down until upper arms are parallel, no deeper. Stop if the shoulder complains.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof press
exercises.notes: 10 each side. Ribs down, don't let the cable turn you.
